verdict.rationale: Codex Cloud runs isolated cloud agents that build and test code, produce a diff/summary, and open a PR for review, directly matching the build-test-demo-review workflow (codex-docs-1,3,5,6). Community evidence confirms real usage of the cloud/local agent completing substantive tasks, though quality varies by model version. Missing for 10: no first-party evidence of an integrated 'demo' artifact (e.g., live preview/deployment) beyond diff/PR review, and independent verification of end-to-end cloud task reliability is mixed.
